panels.title: Last scrape
panels.description: The scraper runs every 10 minutes by default.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM user_bulletin_subscriptions WHERE enabled AND deleted_at IS NULL)
     + (SELECT count(*) FROM bulletin_subscriptions WHERE enabled) AS "subscriptions"
SELECT count(*) AS "matches" FROM bulletin_user_matches WHERE $__timeFilter(matched_at)
SELECT count(*) AS "pushed" FROM bulletin_user_matches WHERE $__timeFilter(pushed_at)

panels.title: New bulletins per day by unit

targets.rawSql:
WITH days AS (
    SELECT generate_series(date_trunc('day', $__timeFrom()::timestamptz, 'Asia/Taipei'), $__timeTo()::timestamptz, interval '1 day') AS day
),
counts AS (
SELECT date_trunc('day', first_seen_at, 'Asia/Taipei') AS day, COALESCE(canonical_org, raw_publisher, 'unknown') AS metric, count(*) AS value
FROM bulletins
WHERE $__timeFilter(first_seen_at) AND source IN (${source:sqlstring})
GROUP BY 1, 2
),
metrics AS (SELECT DISTINCT metric FROM counts)
SELECT d.day AS "time", m.metric, COALESCE(c.value, 0) AS value
FROM days d
CROSS JOIN metrics m
LEFT JOIN counts c ON c.day = d.day AND c.metric = m.metric
ORDER BY 1

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(matched_at, '1h', 0), count(*) AS "matched", count(pushed_at) AS "pushed"
FROM bulletin_user_matches
WHERE $__timeFilter(matched_at)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: LLM request time, p95
panels.description: From the backend's own metrics: one classify request to llama-server.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT first_seen_at AS "first seen", source AS "source", COALESCE(canonical_org, raw_publisher) AS "unit",
       COALESCE(title_clean, title) AS "title", importance AS "importance",
       array_to_string(content_tags, ', ') AS "tags", processing_state AS "state",
       processing_attempts AS "attempts", left(processing_error, 200) AS "error"
FROM bulletins
WHERE NOT is_deleted AND source IN (${source:sqlstring})
  AND (${search:sqlstring} = '' OR concat_ws(' ', title, title_clean, raw_publisher, canonical_org) ILIKE '%' || ${search:sqlstring} || '%')
ORDER BY first_seen_at DESC
LIMIT 300

SELECT left(COALESCE(processing_error, 'unknown'), 80) AS "error", count(*) AS "bulletins"
FROM bulletins
WHERE processing_state = 'failed' AND NOT is_deleted AND source IN (${source:sqlstring})
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC
LIMIT 10

panels.title: Tags
panels.description: LLM-assigned tags on bulletins first seen in range.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT tag AS "tag", count(*) AS "bulletins"
FROM bulletins, unnest(content_tags) AS tag
WHERE NOT is_deleted AND $__timeFilter(first_seen_at) AND source IN (${source:sqlstring})
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC
LIMIT 15
